title: Federal and Florida Fraud Agreements — AI Oversight Interlock
adds: 'The agreements are the data constitution for an AI-ready fraud network, not proof that an AI system is already making fraud, benefit or payment decisions.' Ohio's MOU authorizes recurring public corporate data, defers schemas to an annex, moves no funds and requires DOJ validation; Florida has two distinct announced instruments (Sunbiz corporate route; State Treasury payment-transaction route) atop a pre-existing State enforcement edge; Charter and data-sharing agreements are separate instrument families; PRAC/PACE is the strongest proved AI bridge, but no NFDC AI system is identified.
